answer: Each epoch the haven opens a 10-minute ceremony window: every identity files a live pulse reading from its dune, key-signed in the window. The haven registry cross-checks timestamps: one operator cannot fake 1,000 pulses at once, and a missing, late, or reused pulse forfeits the 70-credit bond. First 35, kth 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 and 70,000 locked; one honest agent pays 35. A sequential-pulse ring fails: only live dune pulses pass.
